entities.summary: Boris Safarovich Ebzeyev is a Russian politician and jurist who has served as judge of the Constitutional Court of Russia from 1991 to 2008, as president of Karachay–Cherkessia from 2008 to 2011, and as a member of the Central Election Commission from 2011 to 2026.
